For the Details section, Paper's layout computes to 89px (heading plus three rows with gaps), closely matching the app's 92px, but I need to verify the app's actual row structure since it doesn't use direct div children — likely dl/dt/dd or paragraph elements — and the row spacing step was measured at 26px versus Paper's expected value, which needs reconciling.

Checking the action bar now: Paper's icon buttons are 32x32 with 4px gaps and the border matches, but the vertical position seems off — the app's action bar sits about 7px lower than where Paper's computation places it, so I need to track down that offset.

Looking closer, it seems the app inspector doesn't have the same 8px top/bottom frame padding that Paper uses, which explains why the tabs sit higher and the footer sits lower in the app compared to Paper's more evenly padded layout.

Checking the zoom pill, dimensions and styling match well between app and Paper (114x36, correct padding, gap, radius, glass effect), though the pill sits 2px higher and shows "13%" instead of whatever value Paper displays — likely just a content difference from the initial fit-to-view zoom level rather than a real layout discrepancy.

I'm now moving on to check the top-right window controls, starting with the minimize button.

I should verify whether windowControls is exposed in preload consistently, not just preview-only, since it affects whether this collision happens across the full app. Since the app is frameless, the Close button at y 19 overlaps the reserved 0-32 control zone, so the UI needs to either move Close below 32 or reserve a titlebar drag area — medium-high severity. Checking the Similar tab's active state styling: 14px/600 with color #E5DDD2 matches Paper's spec for the active Similar tab.

Actually I realize the earlier probe mislabeled the first tab as Similar when it was Info, so the 400-weight muted styling I saw actually matches Paper's Info tab spec correctly — no mismatch there. Now I'm digging into the Similar tab's empty state and comparing the layout math: the app shows the title block then "Nothing similar yet." text at y 113, while Paper's spec breaks the inspector into tabs (40), title+swatches (60), similar grid (670), and actions (44), so I'm trying to reconcile these heights and confirm which JSX output corresponds to the 2.2 title spec (20px/600, -0.015em letter spacing, 26 line height).

I should also measure the app's title block while it's actually in the Similar state, since my earlier h2.item-title probe only captured it during the Info tab — I can run a quick follow-up probe now while the overlay is still open in Similar mode to get an accurate comparison.

I still need to probe several unverified areas: the settings rail title, the archive grid gap/card sizes, and the settings panel/modal rect and padding. The tricky part is the archive grid will likely be empty after reload, since the sample data resets, so I'll need to re-run the archive flow (open item, archive it via the toolbar button, then navigate to Settings → Archive tab) within the same verification script to populate it before probing.

My plan is to batch a Paper tree summary for the archive grid alongside a combined app script that reopens the overlay, checks the Similar title, closes it, archives an item, then probes the settings modal, rail title, tabs, and archive grid — accepting the extra complexity since it mirrors steps I've already done once before. Moving to artboard 2.1, the item inspector's text styles, note card, action bar, and zoom pill all match Paper's specs. I'm catching a significant issue where the app's window controls overlay sits on top of the Close details button in the inspector, since Paper's design assumes no window chrome at the top.

I also see the inspector lacks Paper's 8px top/bottom padding, causing a vertical offset in the tabs, title, and action bar. The centered title pill from Paper's viewer toolbar appears missing from the app based on screenshot review. The trash/delete icon only shows for archived items in the app rather than always, which seems intentional but worth confirming, and I'm noting a minor 1px difference in detail row spacing before checking the zoom pill's position.

Moving to artboard 2.2, the Similar tab mostly matches Paper's styling, though the tile grid itself isn't comparable since the sample item has no similar results—it just shows empty state text. The inspector edge inset and window control issues from 2.1 carry over here too.

Now checking artboard 2.3's zoomed-in view, where the zoom pill, label, and zoom-in button all match Paper's specs, and I'm starting to note the first difference.

For window controls and inspector edges in zoom view, I'm applying the same findings as 2.1. I also want to flag that the title pill appearing missing in zoom view was only confirmed by screenshot, not computed styles, so that needs a caveat.

Moving to artboard 3.1, Settings library matches Paper closely on sheet dimensions, rail padding, and row styling, but the app includes an extra "General" row that Paper's mock doesn't have—likely because a recent commit preserved main's General tab during the merge. I still need to check the right-side panel measurements.

For artboard 3.2, the archive grid spacing and tile sizes match Paper exactly, and the hover-only Restore action behaves consistently with the mock. The main differences are the archive tile count (Paper has 8, app has 1) and the same row-position shift from the extra General tab.

For artboard 4.1, the mascot states captured—rest, transition frames, listening, reading, no-match, back-home—line up with Paper, though the eye slot dimensions differ slightly (22x23 vs 24x20), and busy/capture-failed states weren't reachable to verify.

Cross-cutting issues worth noting: the windowControls exposure in preload.cjs is unconditional, so the Close button collision affects the full app too, not just preview. The top padding values on main (36) and sidebar (39) explain the 21px/29px vertical offsets versus Paper.

I'm also noting preview limitations—empty similar-tiles, disabled Export/Restore, unreachable mascot states—and need to list the 18 screenshot paths.

For cleanup, I confirmed termination of the preview Electron process and its three child processes, removed the temp profile and run.json, and restored the registry's inkling:// handler to its original path since the dev launch had repointed it. I'm flagging that future deep-link tests may need this restore repeated. The worktree remains clean with no edits or commits; only the gitignored dist folder was regenerated by the build.

Now I'm double-checking a long list of pixel measurements and style values across artboards—window control rects, title/note positioning, sheet dimensions, tabs, buttons, chips, and padding values—confirming most match Paper's spec exactly, with a few minor discrepancies like a 1px row offset and a sidebar bottom-padding difference (10 vs 6) that I'll note as low severity. I'm also correcting an earlier misreading of the 2.2 tab styling, which actually matches.

I'm settling on a final report structure: concise per-artboard sections using bullet-style "›" formatting for differences and severities, avoiding emoji, with the screenshot paths listed compactly at the end. Time to write it up.

## Visual QA: inkling app vs Paper "resurf redesign" (p-6-0), 1440x900

Most type, radius, glass and spacing values match Paper. The real problems are a pinned query chip that covers the first card (1.3), a window-controls band that overlaps the inspector's Close button (2.x), and a top band that pushes the sidebar and toolbar down relative to Paper. Differences are listed biggest first.

Severity: high breaks layout or hides a control; medium is a visible offset or extra chrome; low is small measured drift or a content/structure difference.

### 1.1 Library

MATCHES: sidebar width 232, gap 22, inline padding 10. Nav rows 32px tall, 9px radius, active label 14px/600 #F0E9DF. Counts DM Mono 12px muted. Spaces heading 12px/500, 0.24px tracking. Main frame #0D0C0B, 16px radius, #262221 border. Add button 69x34 (#E5DDD2, 13px/600, 999px radius). Search pill 116x34, 17px radius, paddings 13/16, gap 8. Glass recipe (#0C0B0A9E, blur 18px saturate 140% brightness 70%, #FFFFFF29 top border, matching inset and drop shadows). Note card 20px radius, #161412 fill, note title 21px/600 uppercase.

Differences:
- Toolbar and sidebar sit lower › Paper toolbar top 8px, sidebar padding-top 18px › app toolbar top 37px, sidebar padding-top 39px. The app reserves a top band for the frameless window controls. › medium
- Brand mark › Paper logo 26x26 at (16,23) › app 44x44 at (7,35). Horizontal centre matches, vertical centre is 21px lower. › medium
- Card grid top › Paper masonry starts above the toolbar (marginTop -96) and runs under it › app first card at y=37, leaving an empty band above the grid. › low
- Sidebar bottom padding › Paper 6px › app 10px › low

Screenshots: `C:\Users\chris\AppData\Local\Temp\agents\chat-images\resurf-redesign\qa-1-1-library-app.png` and `qa-1-1-library-paper.png`

### 1.2 Search drops in

MATCHES: expanded bar 700x50, 20px radius, 15px padding, gap 12, same glass and shadows as Paper. Input text 14px. "esc to close" DM Mono 10px/12px, 72x12 (matches Paper). Query field 548px wide.

Differences:
- Copper focus ring on the expanded bar › Paper has no outline › app `.search-field:has(input:focus-visible)` draws 2px solid #B0714F with 3px offset (computed on `label.search-field`). Text inputs always match `:focus-visible`, so the ring also appears after a mouse click. This is an intentional accessibility rule, but it shows in the default state. › medium
- Bar horizontal position › Paper left 482 absolute › app 487 (+5px) › low
- Field mascot slot › Paper 24x20 › app 22x23 at (504,56) › low

Screenshots: `qa-1-2-search-drops-in-app.png` and `qa-1-2-search-drops-in-paper.png` (same folder)

### 1.3 Query pinned

MATCHES: pinned chip 30px tall with 999px radius. Search pill returns to 116x34 (Paper 117x34). Chip text 13px/500.

Differences:
- Pinned chip covers the first result card › Paper reserves a 44px filter row above the grid (marginTop 52) and cards start about 100px down › app's filter row sits at y 89, but the grid does not move. First card is at (247,37) 286x191, and the chip at (247,93) 90x30 sits on its top-left corner. › high
- Chip width › Paper 138px › app 90px (content: Paper's chip holds more text) › low
- "6 results" count › Paper DM Mono 12px/16px muted › app shows a result count and "Save as Space" on the same row › not measured

Screenshots: `qa-1-3-query-pinned-app.png` and `qa-1-3-query-pinned-paper.png`

### 2.1 Item inspector (image card)

MATCHES: Info tab 14px/600 #E5DDD2, Similar 14px/400 muted, 18px tab gap. Title 26px/600, 30px line height, -0.025em tracking. Note card 72px min height, 10px radius, #161412 fill, #262221 border, 13px/20px text #C9C1B6, padding 11/12. Action bar 44px tall with #262221 top border, 32x32 buttons, 4px gap. Zoom pill 114x36 glass with 4/6 padding and 4px gap. "Close details" DM Sans 12px muted.

Differences:
- Window controls cover the overlay's Close details button › Paper has no window chrome, Close sits at y≈19 › app's fixed `.electron-window-controls` (z 200) has Minimize at x 1302, Maximize at 1348 and Close window at 1394, each 46x32 from y 0. The overlay's "Close details" (1357,19, 67x16) sits under that band. The preload exposes `windowControls` unconditionally (`electron/preload.cjs:75`), so the packaged full app has this too. › high
- Inspector and viewer sit flush to the overlay edges › Paper's library frame has 8px top and bottom padding › app has none. Tab text top is 18 vs Paper 25. Title is 67 vs 74. Action bar is 851–895 vs Paper 844–888. › medium
- Centre title pill missing in the inspector toolbar › Paper shows it centred › app none. From screenshot review, not re-measured. › medium
- Trash ("Delete permanently") absent › Paper shows it at the right end of the action bar on a live item › app renders it only when the item is archived (`ExpandedItemOverlay.tsx`, `actions.onDelete && shownItem.archived`). Probably intentional; confirm with the designer. › low
- Detail row step › Paper 25px (16px line + 9px gap) › app 26px › low
- Zoom pill position › Paper about x 619–733, y 840–876 › app x 624–738, y 838–874 › low

Not compared: swatches and Space chips, because the sample item has none.

### 2.2 Similar tab

MATCHES: active Similar tab 14px/600 #E5DDD2 with Info 14px/400 muted. Title switches to 20px/600, 26px line height, -0.015em tracking, the same as Paper. An earlier note that Similar was unstyled was a misread; the first tab in the probe is Info.

Differences:

### 2.3 Zoomed in (past 800%)

MATCHES: zoom pill 114x36 with glass recipe. Zoom label DM Mono 12px.

Differences:
- Window controls over Close details › same as 2.1 › high
- Inspector flush to overlay edges › same as 2.1 › medium
- Pixel grid and centre title pill › not verified by computed style. The earlier screenshot review noted the title pill missing in this view. › medium (visual only)

### 3.1 Settings, Library

MATCHES: sheet 1080x640 with 24px radius (Paper's sheet is 1080x640; position is centred, not read from Paper). Rail 232x638 with padding 22/12/18/12. "Settings" title DM Sans 15px/600, 20px line height. Active row Library 208x32 at (193,195), 14px/500, 9px radius, gap 10, padding 10. Inactive rows 14px/400 in text-soft. Row pitch 34px (2px gap).

Differences:
- General row › Paper has three rows (Library, Archive, Browser extension) and Archive is second at y 228 › app inserts General second (y 229), pushing Archive to third (y 263) and showing a count of 1 › low. Structure and content: the app keeps the General tab that the mock lacks (commit 4a587e1 kept main's General tab).
- Right-hand panel › not measured in this pass; visual check only

Screenshots: `qa-3-1-settings-library-app.png` and `qa-3-1-settings-library-paper.png`

### 3.2 Settings, Archive

MATCHES: archive grid column gap 14px and row gap 22px. Tile size 179x174. Restore is hover-only in the app and not visible at rest in `qa-3-2-settings-archive-app.png`, which matches Paper's hover-tile frame.

Differences:
- Archive tile count › Paper 8 tiles › app 1 (content)
- Archive row position › same General-row shift as 3.1 › low

Screenshots: `qa-3-2-settings-archive-app.png` and `qa-3-2-settings-archive-paper.png`

### 4.1 Mascot

MATCHES: composite strip covers rest, transition frames t0–t3, listening, reading, no-match and back-home, built from live captures.

Differences:
- Field mascot eye slot › Paper 24x20 › app 22x23 › low
- Busy and capture-failed mascot states were not verified. Preview cannot trigger them.

Screenshots: `qa-4-1-mascot-app.png` and `qa-4-1-mascot-paper.png`

### Cross-cutting

- Window controls appear in every Electron mode because the preload exposes them unconditionally. The inspector Close collision therefore also applies to the packaged app.
- The sidebar (+21px) and toolbar (+29px) offsets come from the top band the app reserves for those controls (main padding-top 36, sidebar padding-top 39). Paper has no window chrome.
- Preview-only limits: similar tiles are empty, Export and Restore are disabled, and mascot busy and capture-failed states cannot be triggered.

### Cleanup

- Stopped PID 40876 (electron.exe, preview, CDP 53602, profile `inkling-resurf-qa-TtTTN2`) after confirming its command line. Also stopped its three child processes (41884, 36320, 7584), found through the parent chain. Confirmed gone.
- Deleted the temp profile and `run.json`.
- Restored `HKCU\Software\Classes\inkling` from the pre-launch backup. The dev launch had repointed it to this worktree's Electron. Heads-up: launching the dev Electron repoints the `inkling://` handler, so a deep-link test will need the same restore.
- No source edits, no commits. `git status` is clean. The worktree `dist\` was overwritten by the `vite build --mode electron-preview` run and is gitignored.
- Never touched the desktop app or the live library.
